cohort: 242 women with postpartum hemorrhage in the last 6 years (2013-2018) in the city maternity hospital of Bukhara
finding: Only about 20% of women who had postpartum hemorrhage underwent early rehabilitation in the form of prescribing contraceptives.
mod_finding: In 101 women (79.5%) with postpartum bleeding, childbirth was via operative methods.
